title: Feasibility of a Shortened Dental-dedicated Magnetic Resonance Imaging Acquisition Protocol for Dentomaxillofacial Imaging: A Pilot Study
html: Dental-dedicated magnetic resonance imaging (ddMRI) offers hard and soft tissue visualization and inflammatory condition assessment without ionizing radiation. This study evaluated the feasibility of a shortened ddMRI acquisition protocol for general dentomaxillofacial assessment (GDA) and apical periodontitis (AP).
